engine_basis: Zend/zend_builtin_functions.c::debug_backtrace_get_args dereferences and copies each top-level argument but does not recursively dereference an array. Nested reference zvals therefore survive in the captured trace array while direct sibling values retain their copy-on-write snapshot.

Zend/zend_hash.c::zend_hash_compare_impl descends through array count, key and value order; Zend/zend_operators.c::zend_compare dereferences reference values at the reached leaf. The model's spec/semantics/36-arrays.watsup::$entry_value reads ALIAS from the current defined cell.
scope: Normal nonpending loose/ordered comparison of distinct live canonical same-kind builtin Exception/Exception or Error/Error pairs with cold physical string caches and null previous links. Each allocated canonical trace/frame/args graph has DIRECT top-level arguments. Descendant allocated arrays form finite acyclic paths and contain only DIRECT primitive/validated string-carrier leaves, DIRECT child arrays or ALIAS entries to allocated live REFCELLs holding defined primitive/validated string-carrier values. At least one ALIAS is reachable from captured args. Shared child DAGs and repeated cells are admitted. Object/array-valued cells, object leaves, callbacks, cycles, warm caches, previous links and pending comparisons are outside the cut.
